facts.incoming: hurt first reads the DIRECT entity, current target and calculateRange(source) causing-actor squared distance. Reactive counter handling runs first. Direct Abyss Fireball with ANY Ignis causing entity rejects unconditionally; otherwise IS_PROJECTILE-tagged direct Abyss Fireball increments shield durability on server while below3, even if a later admission branch rejects. ULTIMATE_ATTACK or phase0 HP<=maxHP*2F/3F or phase1 HP<=maxHP*1F/3F halves damage via double0.5 then float unless BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. PHASE_2/PHASE_3/STRIKE reject unless that tag; direct ordinary Ignis Fireball always rejects. Positive directional shield blocking returns false. Remaining calls arm destroyBlocksTick20 if nonpositive BEFORE shared hurt, then return the unchanged shared boolean; crackiness-change sound is only a true-return cosmetic callback.
facts.counter: Only nonnull direct entity, AI enabled and blockingProgress==10 OR swordProgress==10 enter the reactive block. With alive target, NO_ANIMATION, nextFloat*100<12, counter cooldown<=0 and causing squared range<225, set cooldown360 then animation COUNTER or SHIELD_BREAK_COUNTER according to break flag. Counter ticks>16<=46 send STRIKE; broken counter ticks>8<=38 send SHIELD_BREAK_STRIKE. Each transition occurs before returning false unless BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. No shared hurt success is required for selection or transitions; later offensive strike payloads are deferred.
facts.shield: For positive damage, canBlockDamageSource rejects shield-bypass tags, exempts direct Abyss Fireball when its causing actor is not Ignis, and requires getIsShield. A nonnull source position is normalized in3D toward boss, then Y set0; dot with native view vector(1F)<0 admits the shield block. hurt calls inherited hurtCurrentlyUsedShield (native LivingEntity no-op for this hierarchy), then for nonprojectile-tagged DIRECT LivingEntity calls blockUsingShield; finally returns false without shared hurt. The callback asks that direct attacker blockedByShield(Ignis); native default LivingEntity recoil requests knockback0.5 and retains virtual/native mitigation.
facts.shield_state: Blocking and sword flags are mutually cleared only when their setter is given true. Per concrete tick on both sides, each stance progress moves by1 toward0/10; hurt counter admission reads exact10. Server target-nonnull sets targetless timer200 and blocking unless broken, else sword. Native idle expiry clears stances. Only full blocking enables the per-animation IS_SHIELD window table; outer failure writes false, unlisted inner animations retain previous IS_SHIELD. Direct reflected-Abyss tagged attempts increment durability while below3 before later hurt admission; idle alive AI tick chooses BREAK_THE_SHIELD for durability>2 and unbroken. Its aiStep sets ShowShield false at25 and break flag true at79. Phase>1 server tick outside PHASE_3 also sets break true.
facts.shield_setters: setIsShieldBreak(true) changes blocking to sword only if currently blocking, sets durability3 and ShowShield false, then stores flag. It does not directly clear IS_SHIELD. false only stores flag and does not restore durability/display/stances. Raw durability setter is unclamped. These state gates are not scalable contributions; ShieldExplode and break-animation offensive payloads remain deferred.
facts.phase: After stance updates/cooldowns, concrete tick when alive prioritizes: AI-enabled idle durability>2 and unbroken -> BREAK_THE_SHIELD; else AI-enabled idle HP<=maxHP*2F/3F and phase<1 -> PHASE_2; else HP<=maxHP*1F/3F and phase<2 -> PHASE_3. Target/LOS are not prerequisites. Native phase2 aiStep commits BossPhase1 at animation tick34; phase3 commits2 at58 and hides shield. There is no local server guard on selection/these commits. Phase>1 server tick outside PHASE_3 sets shield broken. setBossPhase only stores the raw synced integer, with no HP, attribute, home or shield mutation.
facts.phase_setter: Phase thresholds are live current HP conditions with float multiply/divide order; saved phase is a separate latched integer. PHASE_2/3 are incoming immunity identities even before commit. Loaded phase2 does not itself start PHASE_3. Priority1 phase goals use native MOVE/JUMP/LOOK animation goals; phase3 and break goal hold X/Z while preserving Y. Phase2 reuses locked AttackAnimationGoal2. Phase damage, ShieldExplode, roar/control and offensive follow-ups are deferred.
facts.defense: Installed concrete getters bind DamageCap20, DpsCap14 and RangeLimit15 to locked LLibrary admission. DamageCap is per-hit ceiling AND requested-damage bucket capacity; DpsCap/20 drains that bucket per eligible AI server tick. Current causing actor receives full range through15, falloff15<d<22.5 and reject d>=22.5; anonymous causing-null skips range. No concrete or intermediate Cataclysm isInvulnerableTo override exists; registered type is fireImmune. Native armor10 and knockback resistance1 remain separate native defenses; constructor applies native health/attack config multipliers1 to base HP450/attack14.
facts.regen: NatureRegen returns float(Ignis.natureHeal), installed25. Existing shared targetless AI server cadence20, self_regen timer, positive-value guard and native heal admission/max-HP hooks remain unchanged; HealCooldown inherited200. Successful shared tagged hurt resets timer; early bypass and concrete rejected hits do not reset it. This is a concrete binding of shared_heal, not another delivered heal.
facts.persistence_encounter: Synced defaults are BossPhase0, ShieldDurability0, blocking/shield/break/sword false, ShowShield true. Concrete NBT saves BossPhase, Is_Shield_Break, Shield_Durability after shared Home persistence. Load sets phase, then break setter, then raw durability; saved durability can overwrite the break setter3. No stance/admission flag/progress, target vector, animation/tick, targetless/counter/terrain timer or shared bucket/regen/home timer is saved here. finalizeSpawn only delegates to shared; it initializes native home timer but no actual home. Fire altar slot0 must contain Burning Ashes; maintained summoningticks>121 performs terrain-clear calls, creates Ignis, and only ServerLevel+nonnull instance enters add: spawn X/Z+.5,Y+3, home=current dimension/altar pos. Only successful native addFreshEntity empties item slot; failed attempts repeat while item stays, with no nearby boss/player/difficulty/defeat-state gate in this path. Altar inventory persists, summoning timer does not.
